propositions: Pandoc 3.6.1 silently corrupts content: escaping punctuation inside code spans, deleting HTML comments, and rewriting `-->` when substituting arrows, requiring post-render code-preservation fallback.
A two-phase lexer must lock complete {noformat} spans, HTML comments, backtick/tilde fences, and four-space-indented blocks before classifying intervening text to prevent re-rendering oscillation.

An inline-Jira classifier must distinguish UNAMBIGUOUS wiki markers ([label|target], {color:name}, {{monospace}}) from AMBIGUOUS ones (*strong*, _emphasis_) to prevent 2-cycle rendering instability on pre-existing wiki.

ASCII tables (>=2 pipe-bearing lines with delimiter row) must be wrapped exactly once in {noformat}, and all code fragments must appear byte-identically in output or the unit falls back to original Markdown.

A deterministic 178-body scrubbed fixture (29 code-arrow, 29 table, 120 prose) with pinned strata and corpus-level coverage targets (body ratio >=0.90, character ratio >=0.95) must prevent silent store growth from eroding test signal.

Missing pypandoc must return the body unchanged with a content-free wiki_render_fallback event (reason: pandoc_absent); conversion or preservation failure must return the unit unchanged and debug-log only the failure reason.
